Definition: Micah, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Micah or Micaiah or Michah = "who is like God"; 1) the 6th in order of the minor prophets; a native of Moresheth, he prophesied during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah of Judah, and was contemporary with the prophets Hosea, Amos, and Isaiah; 2) an Ephraimite during the period of the judges; 3) a descendant of Joel the Reubenite; 4) son of Meribbaal and grandson of Jonathan; 5) a Kohathite Levite, the eldest son of Uzziel the brother of Amram; 6) father of Abdon, a man of high station in the reign of Josiah; 7) son of Imlah and a prophet of Samaria who predicted the defeat and death of king Ahab of Israel
